comment: BLUS30443 version 1.00, the US disc, BLES00932 version 1.00, the European disc, and BCJS30022 and BCAS20071, the Japanese and Asian discs with their 1.04 update: the versions the port supports (docs/51 appendix A). SHA-256 sums and sizes only: no bytes of the game. sha256 null = not measured yet; then the file is checked by its magic instead. "digital" (the US and European discs): the PlayStation Store version of that disc, the same program and data but for PARAM.SFO's system version, its EBOOT.BIN and its plain .sdat files (gamefiles.py).

BLES00932.comment: The European disc (English, French, German, Spanish and Italian), version 1.00. Its files are the US disc's but for these, and 211 more files of its four other languages.

BCJS30022.comment: The japanese disc with its 1.04 update, which brings the program and its data to the US disc's build (docs/139 section 7.1).

BCAS20071.comment: The asian disc with its 1.04 update, which brings the program and its data to the US disc's build (docs/139 section 7.1).
